params.body:
## What

`test/account-failover.test.mjs` now points `TW_LLM_DOWN_FILE` at its own temporary file and sets `CLAUDE_ACCOUNTS=a1,a2` before it loads `models.mjs`, the same way `one-dead-login`, `auth-refusal` and `declared-keys` already do. Only the test changes.

## Why

The test read the machine's real login-down marker (`/tmp/tw-llm-down.json`). `accountsToTry` skips an account marked down, so whenever a login on the box is refused, three of these tests see one account where they expect two.

That happened on 15 October 2026. With a1 refused on the box, the auto-deploy ran the suite on the merge of #340 and failed "offers every account when none is marked", "a marker whose time has passed does not skip anything" and "re-tests everything rather than believing that all are out". It kept the box on #339. A rejected commit is not retried, so #340 stays out until a new commit lands.

## Tests

- Reproduced with a marker that has a2 down: 4 of 5 tests fail before this change, 5 of 5 pass after it. A marker with a1 down fails the box's three tests, plus the own-account test when `CLAUDE_ACCOUNT` is unset.
- Full suite: 1192 of 1198; the 6 failures are the known report-render tests that need Chromium, unchanged.
params.title: Account failover tests own their login-down marker
